notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Medium and Hard AI to stop progressing
[*] Improved AI behavior.
[*] Now idle units will react to attacks even if the attack range is insufficient.
[*] Made changes to mission 4.
[*] Optimization was performed.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.05 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45139147/774afd12621f598089265df306f89cb8aabe1076.png[/img]
Thank you to everyone who bought my game! If you liked it, don't forget to leave a review, this will help me release updates further ^_^

[list]
[*] Added new mission "Sea Battle".
[*] "Sea Battle" mode added to skirmish for single and multiplayer games (map: 2_SeaBattle).
[*] Added AI for "Sea Battle" mode.
[*] Infantry attack range has been reduced.
[*] Added a 3 second delay before mines explode.
[*] Artillery shells no longer damage allies.
[*] Fixed bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game training has been supplemented.
[*] Added sound effects for completing subtasks.
[*] Increased the speed of using the abilities "Orbital Strike", "Eraser", "Elemental Control"
[*] Balance changes:
 - Increased the production time of infantry with machine guns and missilemen by 1 sec.
 - Decreased the production time of tanks by 1 sec.
 - Decreased the production time of artillery by 2 sec.
[*] Made corrections to the translation.
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect calculation of the ink statistics graph.
[*] Added 2 hidden achievements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v.0.94
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] Added 2 new levels to the "Challenges" mode.
[*] Added the ability to select all units of the same type with a double-click.
[*] Added the ability to choose the formation direction of units during movement.
[*] Added the option to sell your buildings.
[*] Reworked the "Orbital strike" ability: damage now depends on the speed of the magnifying glass.
[*] Fixed a bug related to unit upgrades.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]
